The team met on Tuesday to decide how the daemon should store events. Two options were on the table: an append-only log in SQLite, or a simple directory of JSON files with one file per event. SQLite won because it gives us transactions, cheap indexing by room and timestamp, and a single file that is easy to back up. The main worry was write contention when several agents publish at once, but WAL mode handles that well enough for the expected load of a few events per second.
